notes.title: Isle of Birds - v1.0.3 Patch Release
notes.notes:
Small patch update for you all today!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved issue with UI scaling on ultrawide displays
[*] Added coloured backgrounds to Birds in the Progression Display for Clarity
[*] Updated Leaderboard to always display your best score rather than your most recent score on game over
[*] Fixed minor rendering issue with Text in the Screen Resolution dropdown
[/list]

notes.title: Isle Of Birds on Mac!
notes.notes:
Hey fellow bird-island cultivators!

I'm excited to announce today that we've now published a build of Isle of Birds for Mac OSX!
In combination with this, we've made some minor fixes to small bugs in the game and some small content changes

Enjoy!
~ Felix and Cuba
(Obfuscate Interactive and Shiba Dog Studios)

notes.title: Isle Of Birds v1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The time has come! [b]Isle Of Birds is officially live[/b] ːsteamhappyː

We hope you enjoy your time, if you do check it out be sure to tell us what you think via the feedback form and perhaps leave a review if you enjoyed!

Now, go forth and have at it!

~ Felix and Cuba
(Obfuscate Interactive & Shiba Dog Studios)
